title: Rational-tail profile with exact all-length remainder 2.79653

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Curve_N=family.evaluate on ALL N actual bits, with exact alpha=1/(1-beta), SU capacity K^beta/(L+1)^12 and inverse-capacity responses. NEW small/near parameters use largest odd prime at most floor(beta*floor(log2 K)/2)-24ceil_log2(L+1), small output K/(L+1)^12, and reservoir width K^beta/(L+1)^24. First-tie selection minimizes coarse source_certificate u(p); v_N is analysis only. Total uniform P/empty-witness NP verifier; fallback0,v_N=u_N=N+2. NEW rational-tail row profile g(y)=min(1,Cg*sqrt(y)/(1+c*y)),t=4213/10000,c=2179/5000,Cg=(1+c*t^2)/t, replaces previous sqrt(6y) budget; selected plans can differ.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For the actual selected plan, retain ST targets I_u>=O and leaf capacity c. Put v_N=min(d_plan,c+1+sum[(T_u-1)*(I_u-1)]); fallback v_N=u_N=N+2. For EVERY integer N>=0, C_B2(Curve_N)>=4N-8v_N+5>=4N-8u_N+5, by the supplied wholly analytical full-B2 gate theorem. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, v_N<=u_N<=2^ceil(D_curve Z), D_curve=279653/100000=2.79653,Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Hence for every fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(Curve_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and liminf C_B2(Curve_N)/N>=4. This is a new function; no pointwise comparison with Trim_N is asserted.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
